provenance: 16 independent source-grounded audit examples authored before first evaluation of frozen revision feb4aaeca3d1d5132b7cc59c2ef8511d362ea9efa497c9c05b5957243c9e207e. Not used for tuning. Provisional authored labels, not expert or representative validation. Optional alternatives require review rather than automatic failure.

cases.input: I assess patients' health needs and plan their bedside care. I monitor vital signs and changes in symptoms, maintain medical records, and explain recovery and disease prevention to patients.
cases.rationale: Registered Nurses: care assessment/planning, medical records, symptoms and vital signs (tasks1840,1841).

cases.input: I remove deposits and stains from patients' teeth and examine their gums for signs of disease. I record oral health findings and teach patients how to improve brushing and prevent dental problems.
cases.rationale: Dental Hygienists: preventive oral care, cleaning, examining gums and charting (tasks416-418).

cases.input: I teach reading, arithmetic, and social skills to a fourth-grade class. I prepare classroom activities, assess each child's progress, and establish routines that help students learn and behave cooperatively.
cases.rationale: Elementary School Teachers: elementary academic/social skills, behavior, evaluation and classroom preparation (tasks6535-6537).

cases.input: I teach algebra and geometry to high school students through lessons, discussions, and demonstrations. I set learning objectives, prepare subject assignments, assess students' understanding, and manage classroom behavior.
cases.rationale: Secondary School Teachers: secondary subjects, mathematics instruction, objectives and classroom behavior (tasks6639-6641).

cases.input: I fit and repair water pipes in buildings, cutting and threading sections to match the drawings. I assemble connections and pressure-test the installed pipework to locate leaks before it is used.
cases.rationale: Plumbers, Pipefitters and Steamfitters: pipe cutting, drawings and pressure testing (tasks23459-23461); no solar specialization.

cases.input: I install central air conditioning and repair heating and refrigeration equipment. I ask customers about malfunctions, test electrical components, replace defective parts, and check that the system cools or heats correctly.
cases.rationale: HVAC mechanics/installers: electrical testing, replacement and malfunction diagnosis (tasks23552-23554).

cases.input: I design bridges and building structures, calculate load requirements and material stresses, and prepare construction specifications. I inspect project sites to check that the work follows the approved design.
cases.rationale: Civil Engineers: structures, bridges, load/stress calculations and inspection (tasks147,148); no traffic or wastewater specialization.

cases.input: I design industrial machines and tools from customer specifications. I interpret technical drawings, compare design feasibility and maintenance costs, and work with colleagues to resolve equipment malfunctions and operating problems.
cases.rationale: Mechanical Engineers: machines/tools, drawings, malfunctions and feasibility (tasks1411-1413); no automotive or fuel-cell specialization.

cases.input: I examine accounting records, prepare financial statements, and audit statements produced by other teams. I investigate weaknesses in financial controls and write reports explaining the findings and recommended changes to management.
cases.rationale: Accountants and Auditors: statements, auditing, reports and deficient controls (tasks21505-21507).

cases.input: I prepare soups, vegetables, and meat dishes in a restaurant kitchen. I season food according to recipes, stir and turn it while cooking, and check taste and doneness before serving.
cases.rationale: Restaurant cooks: dishes, seasoning, stirring and checking doneness (tasks2169-2171); no supervision.

cases.input: I support lawyers by investigating case facts and researching statutes and previous court decisions. I prepare affidavits and other legal documents, organize case files, and assemble exhibits for trial.
cases.rationale: Paralegals/legal assistants: facts, precedent, affidavits and trial exhibits (tasks1636,18491,18492).

cases.input: I schedule appointments, draft routine office correspondence, and organize paper and electronic files. I answer incoming calls, take messages, and find the documents colleagues need to respond to inquiries.
cases.rationale: Secretaries/admin assistants: appointments, files, calls/messages and locating correspondence (tasks2790,2793). Related office roles can be reasonable alternatives.

cases.input: I analyze product delivery and supply chain processes to find avoidable delays and excess inventory. I recommend operational changes, monitor shipment tracing, and review invoicing and route activity.
cases.rationale: Logistics Analysts: delivery/supply chain analysis, route activity, invoicing, shipment tracing and inventory reduction (task15881); not shipment clerking.

cases.input: I check incoming merchandise against shipment records and record quantities, damage, and discrepancies. I prepare shipping documents and contact carriers to arrange collection and delivery of outgoing goods.
cases.rationale: Shipping/receiving/inventory clerks: verification, documents, discrepancies and carrier arrangements (tasks4737,4739,4740).

cases.input: I help people with their work and deal with different problems. Most days involve projects, meetings, and emails.
cases.rationale: No occupational field or distinctive tasks; should request useful details without candidates.
